caseNameFull: Schwartz v. Irving Trust Co., Trustee

opinions.text: It is ordered that the third and fourth sentences of the opinion delivered in this cause on January 4, 1937, be amended to read as follows: “Their leases were rejected in a bankruptcy proceeding pending when the reorganization section was adopted. All of the leases contained indemnity covenants similar to that considered in No. 354.” The petition for rehearing is denied.
